summary: SBIN Depth dropped to Quote: the L5 feed is cancelled and the book goes, a late book is not cached again, the quote then has no book totals, and Depth held again sends no old book before a fresh one.

deviations.reason: Tradejini sends the trade time in epoch seconds; the web formats it with the server's local time zone into a text such as "2025-11-05 14:25:31" (nxtradstream.py datefmt) and sends that as ltt, where feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends epoch ms, and leaves ltt out when Tradejini sent no trade time, where the web sends null (Quote, Depth) or "" (LTP).

An equity's L1 carries no OI; the web sends oi 0 in Depth, and in a Quote (message.get("OI", 0)), an invented zero. The desktop leaves out a field the stream did not carry (web openalgo#2376; rules.md: no invented data).

Depth was dropped and its book went with it: the web prunes the L5 half (_prune_tick_cache), so its Quote has no totals. The desktop's Quote frame still carries the dropped book's totals, which the bridge's snapshot keeps, because a tick can say a field is missing from its packet but not that it is gone (feed/bridge/snapshot.rs). Needs a carrier mark that withdraws a field (lane wire); the Tradejini feed then withdraws the totals when the book goes.
